health.message: This file is generated from research/countries.json by scripts/gen-metrics.mjs. Umami visitor counts stay 0 until the analytics host is public. No live uptime probe on this origin, so uptimePct24h/latencyMs are omitted rather than reported as null.

dependencies.detail: public/proofs · 21 current programs with a Satohash .ots file on disk (50 other .ots files are not counted)
Script wired (website dd982c5b-…); reverse proxy to THOR:3002 still required for live pageviews

kpis.label: Countries seeded
kpis.hint: Original deep-seed cohort (16/21). This is not the catalog size. Full catalog is programs_total.

kpis.label: Programs total
kpis.hint: CBI/RBI and special programs in research/countries.json.

kpis.label: Countries OTS-stamped
kpis.hint: Current programs with a Satohash proof whose .ots file exists under public/. Historical proofs for retired countries are not counted. Alias: countries_verified_ots.

kpis.label: Avg program cost
kpis.hint: Arithmetic mean of finance.typical_investment_usd across 21 programs with a numeric value, rounded to the nearest dollar.

kpis.label: Fastest pathway
kpis.hint: Derived from low end of finance.processing_time_months in months × 30. A range such as "1-4" uses the low end. Minimum is 30 days, tied across El Salvador (1-4), Vanuatu (1-3), Mexico (1-3). No unique fastest country is claimed. Alias: fastest_citizenship_days.

kpis.label: Target countries
kpis.hint: Live corpus: 21 programs in research/countries.json. Same count as programs_total.

kpis.label: Cheapest program
kpis.hint: Lowest finance.min_investment_usd greater than 0: Spain · $32,000. El Salvador's min_investment_usd is 0 (no stated investment floor), so $0 is not presented as the cheapest citizenship for sale.

steps.label: Browse programs
steps.hint: Umami /programs pageviews once analytics host is public

offers.title: 21-program CBI/RBI oracle
offers.hint: CBI/RBI catalog with finance, pathways, Satohash proofs

education.title: 16 seeded vs 21 programs
education.body: countries_seeded is the original deep-seed cohort (16), not the catalog size. The live corpus is 21 programs: programs_total and target_countries both follow research/countries.json. Pitch 16/21 progress using seeded + target_countries.
education.action: Show seeded/target on HQ card; programs_total on Concert

education.title: OTS is the truth layer
education.body: The live corpus is 21 programs. countries_ots counts those whose Satohash proof has an .ots file on disk under public/ (21 today). Leftover proofs for retired countries are not counted.
education.action: Link HQ card to /verify and Satohash

education.title: Visitor funnel needs public Umami
education.body: Tracking script is in index.html. The live corpus is 21 programs, but funnel counts stay 0 until analytics.giveabit.io (or the THOR reverse proxy) is reachable from the open web. Umami visitor counts stay 0 until the analytics host is public.
